title: Mailboat
html_source: Dublin’s steam-powered mailboats ferried letters and packages from Ireland to Britain twice a day. This sighting helps time this moment to a few minutes after 8:15am. The mailboats also carried passengers between the two islands: in episode 12, “Cyclops”, we learn city councillor Joseph P. Nannetti is taking the evening mailboat to speak in Parliament the next day. This morning mailboat, some researchers hypothesize, may have been the source of the “two strong shrill whistles” that reply to Mulligan’s call at the start of the chapter.
